svg.aria-label: Fireguard map interface: hotspot cells over central Chile and Argentina coloured from purple to yellow, Valparaíso outlined in orange, wind particles drifting across the map, a burn calendar panel with 26 years by month, a layer toolbar, and a timeline of yearly hotspots with a moving playhead.
